name: Jealousy's Hold
source:
Your out at a public park, its such a nice day out! Then you hear someone sniffling, You go up to them, and he looks so down! You eentually find out his name is Lief, now, you decide how your journey goes..

[From [url=https://kitkatcaat.itch.io/jealousys-hold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在公园里，真是美好的一天！然后你听到有人抽鼻子，你走过去，他看上去很沮丧！你最终发现他的名字叫利夫，现在，你决定你的旅程如何进行..

[来自[url=https://kitkatcaat.itch.io/jealousys-hold]Itch.io[/url]]
